$comment: Per-stage deterministic gate definitions consumed by `checks/run.mjs gate-set <name>` (D10). Each set names the rubric it feeds and the checks that produce its deterministic gate results. `gateId` must be a deterministic gate in that rubric; `check` is the registry function that computes it (may differ from the rubric's nominal check name — e.g. write_paths_in_boundary produces the file_ownership gate from the event log). `input`: artifact (path via --artifact), events (path via --events + --stage/--role), or files (paths via --files). The registry-sync self-test in run-all.mjs verifies every gateId is a real deterministic gate of its rubric, every check exists, and every deterministic gate is covered here — so a gate can never silently fail closed for lack of a result.

scaffold.$comment: Deterministic guard run at the scaffold stage over the generated wrangler.jsonc (D11). No rubric/judge — the scaffold is code, so its output is checked, not scored. The evidence engine (P11) re-runs these.

release.$comment: Deterministic release gate over the code-synthesized release-gate.json (D12/D13). No judge — the gate is a fact synthesized from executed evidence, not a scored artifact.

deploy.$comment: Deterministic deploy gate (D19): the release gate is deployable, the deployment report records a real rollback, and every promotion was re-verified. The deployment report is a synthesized fact, not a judged artifact.
